action_units.name: Filter Disease Data
action_units.instruction:
Call `process_disease(in_data_root, output_root, trait)` once for the current trait. The function handles everything end-to-end:
  - Auto-detects whether 'TCGA.csv' exists for the trait. If yes, only TCGA is processed. Otherwise the largest GEO cohort is processed, with automatic fallback to the next-largest cohort when the Disease=1 subset has <10 samples (control case only).
  - Splits samples by trait (Disease=1/0), Age (<40, [40, 60], >60), and Gender (0/1) where the relevant columns exist. Age and Gender splits are taken within Disease=1 for the control case, and over the full dataset otherwise.
  - Saves only subsets with >=10 samples, as gene-only matrices (clinical columns dropped).
  - Maintains an idempotent checkpoint via a `.completed` marker inside each disease's output folder, so reruns skip work that already finished.
  - Logs a WARNING if TCGA Disease=1 has <10 samples (manual fallback to GEO required) or if all GEO cohorts are exhausted without success.
